senses.en: A group or set of four things.
Four chromatids formed when homologous chromosomes pair during meiosis.

ex.en: Under the microscope, we spotted a tetrad of cells.
ex.zh: 在显微镜下，我们发现了一组四个细胞。

ex.en: During meiosis, each tetrad allows genetic material to be exchanged between paired chromosomes, contributing to biological diversity.
ex.zh: 在减数分裂过程中，每个四分体使配对染色体之间能够交换遗传物质，从而促进生物多样性。

col: a tetrad of cells｜一组四个细胞
tip: 专业词；生物学四分体含四条染色单体。

senses.en: The height on a mountain above which trees cannot grow.

ex.en: Above the timberline only grasses survive.
ex.zh: 林木线以上只有草能存活。

senses.en: A plant adapted to survive fire.

ex.en: Pyrophytes have thick, fire-resistant bark.
ex.zh: 耐火植物有厚而耐火的树皮。

senses.en: Having or needing a lot of moisture.

ex.en: Hydric soils are found in wetlands.
ex.zh: 湿地中有湿生土壤。

senses.en: To shorten a written work while keeping its main content.

ex.en: The publisher abridged the novel for younger readers.
ex.zh: 出版社为较年幼的读者推出了这部小说的删节版。

ex.en: Publishers often abridge classic novels to make them more accessible to students with limited reading experience.
ex.zh: 出版社经常删节经典小说，使阅读经验有限的学生更容易读懂。

tip: 删去部分内容但保留主干，不等同于写摘要。

senses.en: Able to survive with little water.

ex.en: Farmers planted drought-resistant wheat.
ex.zh: 农民种植了抗旱小麦。

senses.en: Open land covered with rough grass and low shrubs.

ex.en: Wild ponies roam the heath.
ex.zh: 野马在荒野上游荡。

senses.en: to stop resisting and accept another person's demands

ex.en: After hours of arguing, we capitulated and ordered pizza.
ex.zh: 争论了几个小时后，我们终于让步，点了披萨。

ex.en: Governments should not capitulate to commercial pressure when public health and environmental protection are at stake.
ex.zh: 当公共健康和环境保护受到威胁时，政府不应向商业压力屈服。

col: capitulate to demands｜接受要求而让步
tip: 不及物动词；向某人或压力屈服用capitulate to。

senses.en: Trees cut back to the ground so that they grow many new stems.

ex.en: Hazel was coppiced for poles.
ex.zh: 榛树被平茬用来做杆子。

senses.en: A line of bushes and small trees along a field.

ex.en: Hedgerows give shelter to birds.
ex.zh: 树篱为鸟类提供栖身之所。

senses.en: Making a product or company seem more environmentally friendly than it is.

ex.en: Critics accused the oil company of greenwashing.
ex.zh: 批评者指责这家石油公司“漂绿”。

senses.en: to formally agree to a request, demand, or proposal
to take an important official position, especially as a ruler

ex.en: The landlord finally acceded to our request for repairs.
ex.zh: 房东终于答应了我们提出的维修要求。

ex.en: Governments may accede to public demands for greater transparency when trust in national institutions declines.
ex.zh: 当公众对国家机构的信任下降时，政府可能会同意提高透明度的要求。

col: accede to a request｜答应请求
tip: 正式用语，通常接to；勿与exceed（超过）混淆。

senses.en: Tourism to natural areas that supports conservation.

ex.en: Ecotourism brings income to local villages.
ex.zh: 生态旅游为当地村庄带来收入。

senses.en: The idea that humans have an inborn need to connect with nature.

ex.en: Biophilia explains why people love gardens.
ex.zh: 亲生命性解释了人们为何喜爱花园。

senses.en: Designing products by copying nature.

ex.en: Velcro is a famous example of biomimicry.
ex.zh: 魔术贴是仿生学的著名例子。

senses.en: a long journey involving many difficult or exciting experiences

ex.en: Their cycling odyssey took them across deserts and mountains.
ex.zh: 他们漫长的骑行历程带他们穿越了沙漠和群山。

ex.en: The documentary follows one family's odyssey across several continents, exploring how migration reshapes identity and belonging.
ex.zh: 这部纪录片跟随一个家庭跨越数大洲的漫长旅程，探讨迁移如何重塑身份认同与归属感。

tip: 文学色彩较强，也可比喻人生探索；复数odysseys。

senses.en: A way of farming that works with natural systems to be self-sustaining.

ex.en: Permaculture gardens need little outside input.
ex.zh: 永续农业花园几乎不需要外部投入。

senses.en: The study of how individuals and firms make economic decisions.

ex.en: Microeconomics explains how a single market sets prices.
ex.zh: 微观经济学解释单一市场如何定价。

senses.en: formed from cooled magma or lava

ex.en: Basalt is an igneous rock.
ex.zh: 玄武岩是火成岩。

ex.en: Igneous rocks rarely contain fossils because any remains are destroyed by the intense heat of molten rock.
ex.zh: 火成岩很少含化石，因为熔岩的高温会毁掉任何遗骸。

tip: 三大岩类：igneous、sedimentary、metamorphic。

senses.en: A general fall in prices in an economy.

ex.en: Deflation can make people delay spending.
ex.zh: 通货紧缩会让人们推迟消费。

senses.en: High inflation combined with slow growth and high unemployment.

ex.en: The 1970s were marked by stagflation in many countries.
ex.zh: 20世纪70年代许多国家出现了滞胀。

senses.en: An official order stopping trade with another country.

ex.en: The embargo cut off oil supplies.
ex.zh: 禁运切断了石油供应。

senses.en: of or relating to the thing just mentioned

ex.en: We discussed dinner plans, or rather the lack thereof.
ex.zh: 我们讨论了晚餐安排，确切说，是根本没有安排这回事。

ex.en: Access to public transport, or the lack thereof, strongly influences employment opportunities in rural communities.
ex.zh: 能否使用公共交通，会显著影响农村社区居民的就业机会。

col: any portion thereof｜其中的任何部分
tip: 意为of that，常见于法律文体，不等于therefore。

senses.en: Making laws or controls less strict, especially on trade.

ex.en: Trade liberalization opened new markets.
ex.zh: 贸易自由化开辟了新市场。

senses.en: The removal of government rules controlling an industry.

ex.en: Airline deregulation led to cheaper tickets.
ex.zh: 航空业放松管制带来了更便宜的机票。

senses.en: Selling a state-owned company or service to private owners.

ex.en: The privatization of the railways was controversial.
ex.zh: 铁路私有化颇具争议。

senses.en: Disturbing or frightening because of a connection with death.

ex.en: The old theatre displayed a macabre painting of dancing skeletons.
ex.zh: 那座老剧院陈列着一幅骷髅起舞的恐怖画作。

ex.en: Macabre imagery in literature can encourage readers to reflect on mortality rather than merely provoke fear.
ex.zh: 文学中与死亡有关的恐怖意象可以促使读者思考生命的终结，而不只是引发恐惧。

col: macabre humour｜死亡主题的黑色幽默
macabre imagery｜死亡主题的恐怖意象
tip: 不泛指吓人，通常涉及死亡或令人不安的细节。

senses.en: Bringing a private industry under government ownership.

ex.en: The nationalization of the oil industry changed the economy.
ex.zh: 石油工业国有化改变了经济面貌。

senses.en: A market controlled by a small number of large companies.

ex.en: The mobile phone market is close to an oligopoly.
ex.zh: 手机市场接近寡头垄断。

senses.en: A market controlled by only two companies.

ex.en: Two firms formed a duopoly in aircraft manufacturing.
ex.zh: 两家公司在飞机制造业形成了双头垄断。

senses.en: Abnormal hardening of tissue within the body.

ex.en: The specialist explained that sclerosis involves hardening of body tissue.
ex.zh: 专科医生解释说，硬化涉及身体组织变硬。

ex.en: Multiple sclerosis affects the central nervous system, and its symptoms can vary considerably between individuals.
ex.zh: 多发性硬化症影响中枢神经系统，其症状可能因人而异。

tip: 医学词；multiple sclerosis是多发性硬化症。

senses.en: A group of firms that agree to control prices and limit competition.

ex.en: The oil cartel agreed to cut production.
ex.zh: 石油卡特尔同意减产。

senses.en: Intended to prevent monopolies and protect competition.

ex.en: Regulators opened an antitrust investigation.
ex.zh: 监管机构启动了反垄断调查。

senses.en: To restrict someone's freedom or ability to act.
Something limiting freedom, or a chain securing someone's ankles.

ex.en: Don't let fear fetter your plans to travel alone.
ex.zh: 别让恐惧束缚你独自旅行的计划。

ex.en: Excessive administrative requirements can fetter small businesses, preventing them from investing in innovation and creating jobs.
ex.zh: 过多的行政要求可能束缚小企业，使其无法投资创新和创造就业机会。

col: break free from fetters｜挣脱束缚
tip: 较正式；名词通常用复数fetters。

senses.en: How much demand or supply changes when price changes; also stretchiness.

ex.en: Luxury goods have a high price elasticity of demand.
ex.zh: 奢侈品的需求价格弹性很高。

senses.en: Changing little when price changes.

ex.en: Demand for basic medicine is inelastic.
ex.zh: 对基本药物的需求缺乏弹性。

senses.en: Property promised to a lender if a loan is not repaid.

ex.en: She used her house as collateral for the loan.
ex.zh: 她用房子作为贷款抵押。

senses.en: To cover furniture with padding and fabric or leather.

ex.en: They upholstered the old chair in soft blue velvet.
ex.zh: 他们给那把旧椅子加了软垫，并包上柔软的蓝色天鹅绒。

ex.en: Learning to upholster furniture can help people extend its useful life and reduce household waste.
ex.zh: 学习给家具加装软垫和面料，有助于延长家具的使用寿命并减少家庭垃圾。

col: upholster a chair｜给椅子装软垫及面料
upholstered in leather｜用皮革包面的
tip: 专指给家具装软垫、包面料，不泛指装修。

senses.en: A person or organization that is owed money.

ex.en: The company could not pay its creditors.
ex.zh: 公司无法偿还债权人。

senses.en: A person, company or country that owes money.

ex.en: Debtor nations struggled to repay their loans.
ex.zh: 债务国难以偿还贷款。

senses.en: How easily assets can be turned into cash.

ex.en: Banks need enough liquidity to meet withdrawals.
ex.zh: 银行需要足够的流动性来应对取款。

senses.en: A large flat sea fish, also eaten as food

ex.en: We ordered grilled halibut with potatoes and fresh lemon.
ex.zh: 我们点了烤大比目鱼，配土豆和鲜柠檬。

ex.en: Strict fishing limits can help protect halibut populations while supporting the long-term livelihoods of coastal communities.
ex.zh: 严格的捕捞限额有助于保护大比目鱼种群，同时保障沿海社区的长远生计。

tip: 指鱼时复数通常仍为halibut；指鱼肉时不可数。

senses.en: The state of being unable to pay your debts.

ex.en: The firm was declared in a state of insolvency.
ex.zh: 该公司被宣告无力偿债。

senses.en: A share of a company's profits paid to its shareholders.

ex.en: The company raised its dividend this year.
ex.zh: 公司今年提高了股息。

senses.en: The value of shares in a company; also fairness.

ex.en: Investors bought equity in the startup.
ex.zh: 投资者购买了这家初创公司的股权。

senses.en: operated by compressed air or filled with air

ex.en: Workers used a pneumatic drill to break the pavement.
ex.zh: 工人用风钻凿开路面。

ex.en: Pneumatic systems are widely used in manufacturing because compressed air can power tools safely and efficiently.
ex.zh: 气动系统广泛用于制造业，因为压缩空气能安全高效地驱动工具。

tip: 词首p不发音；常指靠压缩空气驱动的设备。

senses.en: Investments such as stocks and bonds that can be traded.

ex.en: He works in the securities industry.
ex.zh: 他在证券业工作。

senses.en: Spreading activities or investments across different areas to reduce risk.

ex.en: Diversification protects investors from a single market crash.
ex.zh: 分散投资可保护投资者免受单一市场崩盘的影响。

senses.en: A sudden confused mental state, often caused by illness.
A state of extreme excitement or happiness.

ex.en: During his fever, he slipped into delirium and spoke incoherently.
ex.zh: 发烧期间，他陷入谵妄状态，说话语无伦次。

ex.en: Hospital staff need appropriate training to recognise delirium promptly, particularly among older patients recovering from surgery.
ex.zh: 医院工作人员需要接受适当培训，以及时识别谵妄，尤其是术后恢复中的老年患者出现的谵妄。

col: a state of delirium｜谵妄状态
tip: 医学义是急性意识混乱，不等于长期痴呆。

senses.en: Bought in the hope of quick profit; based on guesses.

ex.en: Speculative buying pushed housing prices up.
ex.zh: 投机性购买推高了房价。

senses.en: Buying something in one market and selling it at a higher price in another.

ex.en: Traders profit from arbitrage between exchanges.
ex.zh: 交易者从不同交易所间的套利中获利。

senses.en: A financial product whose value depends on another asset; something developed from something else.

ex.en: Complex derivatives played a role in the financial crisis.
ex.zh: 复杂的金融衍生品在金融危机中起了作用。

senses.en: Having a long-established habit that is unlikely to change.

ex.en: My uncle is an inveterate collector of old maps.
ex.zh: 我叔叔收藏旧地图成癖。

ex.en: Inveterate car users may resist public transport initiatives unless services become substantially more convenient and reliable.
ex.zh: 除非服务变得便捷可靠得多，否则长期习惯开车的人可能会抵触推广公共交通的举措。

col: inveterate traveller｜常年热衷旅行的人
tip: 通常置于名词前，强调长期习惯难以改变。

senses.en: The tendency to change quickly and unpredictably.

ex.en: Market volatility worried investors.
ex.zh: 市场波动让投资者担忧。

senses.en: Happening in cycles, rising and falling regularly.

ex.en: Construction is a cyclical industry.
ex.zh: 建筑业是周期性行业。

senses.en: An improvement in economic activity.

ex.en: An upturn in sales lifted the company's profits.
ex.zh: 销售回升提高了公司利润。

senses.en: a form of an element with a different number of neutrons

ex.en: Carbon has several isotopes.
ex.zh: 碳有几种同位素。

ex.en: By measuring how much of a radioactive carbon isotope remains in bones, scientists can estimate how old they are.
ex.zh: 通过测量骨头中放射性碳同位素的剩余量，科学家能估计其年代。

tip: 放射性碳定年法 radiocarbon dating 的关键概念。

senses.en: Government policies that cut spending to reduce debt.

ex.en: Austerity measures led to protests.
ex.zh: 紧缩措施引发了抗议。

senses.en: The government department that manages public money.

ex.en: The Treasury announced new tax rules.
ex.zh: 财政部宣布了新的税收规定。

senses.en: Financial help given to a failing company or country.

ex.en: The bank received a government bailout.
ex.zh: 这家银行获得了政府救助。

senses.en: Able to be defended or maintained against criticism.

ex.en: His excuse was no longer tenable after we checked.
ex.zh: 我们核实后，他的借口就再也站不住脚了。

ex.en: The assumption that economic growth always improves public wellbeing is no longer tenable in every context.
ex.zh: 经济增长总能改善公众福祉这一假设，已不能在所有情境下成立。

col: a tenable position｜站得住脚的立场
a tenable argument｜经得起推敲的论点
no longer tenable｜不再站得住脚
tip: 常形容论点或立场站得住脚，不等于舒适。

senses.en: A large company made up of many different businesses.

ex.en: The conglomerate owns hotels, airlines and banks.
ex.zh: 这家企业集团拥有酒店、航空公司和银行。

senses.en: A company controlled by a larger company.

ex.en: The firm opened a subsidiary in Brazil.
ex.zh: 该公司在巴西开设了一家子公司。

senses.en: To hold someone or something firmly.
A small fastening that holds something closed.
A firm hold with the hands or arms.

ex.en: She clasped my hand as we crossed the bridge.
ex.zh: 过桥时，她紧紧握住我的手。

ex.en: Young children may clasp a familiar toy during medical appointments because it provides comfort in unfamiliar surroundings.
ex.zh: 幼儿就诊时可能会紧抱熟悉的玩具，因为它能在陌生环境中带来安慰。

col: clasp someone's hand｜紧握某人的手
clasp your hands together｜双手紧握
tip: clasp作动词强调握紧；作名词也可指首饰搭扣。

senses.en: The activity of starting and running new businesses.

ex.en: The university encourages student entrepreneurship.
ex.zh: 这所大学鼓励学生创业。

senses.en: An economic theory that a nation should export more than it imports to build wealth.

ex.en: Mercantilism shaped colonial trade in the 1600s.
ex.zh: 重商主义塑造了17世纪的殖民贸易。

senses.en: A list of employees and the wages they are paid.

ex.en: The company has 500 people on its payroll.
ex.zh: 这家公司的工资单上有500人。

senses.en: A peaceful, happy experience, especially in the countryside.
A poem or short story describing peaceful country life.

ex.en: Our summer idyll ended when the noisy builders arrived.
ex.zh: 吵闹的建筑工人一来，我们宁静美好的夏日生活便结束了。

ex.en: The rural idyll portrayed in tourism campaigns often overlooks the economic difficulties faced by farming communities.
ex.zh: 旅游宣传中描绘的田园乐境往往忽视了农业社区面临的经济困难。

tip: 既可指田园诗，也常指田园般的恬静生活。

senses.en: Having work that does not use your skills fully or gives too few hours.

ex.en: Underemployment is common among new graduates.
ex.zh: 就业不足在应届毕业生中很常见。

senses.en: Paying another company to do work instead of doing it yourself.

ex.en: Outsourcing reduced the firm's costs.
ex.zh: 外包降低了公司的成本。

senses.en: Moving business activities to another country to cut costs.

ex.en: Offshoring moved many factory jobs overseas.
ex.zh: 离岸外包使许多工厂岗位转移到海外。

senses.en: Sounding sad, especially in a gentle or complaining way.

ex.en: A plaintive cry came from the kitten outside our door.
ex.zh: 门外的小猫发出了一声哀怨的叫声。

ex.en: The musician uses a plaintive melody to convey the loneliness experienced by people living far from home.
ex.zh: 这位音乐家用哀伤的旋律表达远离家乡的人所感受到的孤独。

tip: 多形容声音、语调或旋律中流露的哀伤。

senses.en: The amount added to the cost price to set the selling price.

ex.en: Restaurants often put a high markup on drinks.
ex.zh: 餐馆对饮料的加价往往很高。

senses.en: Paying off a debt, or spreading a cost, over a period of time.

ex.en: The amortization schedule shows each monthly payment.
ex.zh: 摊还计划表列出了每月的还款额。

senses.en: A person who officially examines financial records.

ex.en: The auditors questioned some payments.
ex.zh: 审计员对部分付款提出了质疑。

senses.en: Capable of forming ideas or mental images.

ex.en: The philosopher described imagination as a conceptive faculty.
ex.zh: 这位哲学家把想象力描述为一种形成心中构想的能力。

ex.en: In older philosophical writing, the conceptive faculty enables people to form ideas beyond their immediate sensory experience.
ex.zh: 在较早的哲学著作中，构想能力使人能够形成超出当下感官经验的观念。

tip: 罕见词；勿与表示“概念上的”conceptual混用。

senses.en: A book or record in which financial transactions are written.

ex.en: Merchants kept careful ledgers of every sale.
ex.zh: 商人仔细记下每笔交易的账簿。

senses.en: The process of obtaining goods or services, especially for an organization.

ex.en: The army changed its procurement rules.
ex.zh: 军队修改了采购规定。

senses.en: to formally inform someone about something

ex.en: Please apprise me of any changes before Friday.
ex.zh: 如有任何变化，请在周五前告知我。

ex.en: Schools should apprise parents of significant policy changes before introducing new rules that affect their children.
ex.zh: 学校在推行影响孩子的新规定之前，应告知家长重大的政策变化。

col: apprise someone of something｜将某事告知某人
keep someone apprised｜随时向某人通报
tip: 正式用语；用apprise sb of sth，勿混appraise。

senses.en: A focus on buying and owning goods; also protecting buyers' rights.

ex.en: Critics blame consumerism for waste.
ex.zh: 批评者把浪费归咎于消费主义。

senses.en: Creating a name and image for a product in people's minds.

ex.en: Good branding helps a product stand out.
ex.zh: 好的品牌塑造能让产品脱颖而出。

senses.en: A tax on certain goods produced or sold within a country, such as alcohol.

ex.en: Excise duties on tobacco were increased.
ex.zh: 烟草消费税提高了。

senses.en: To a very great degree, especially in a positive way.

ex.en: Your spare room looks eminently suitable for a study.
ex.zh: 你那间空房看起来非常适合用作书房。

ex.en: Improving insulation is an eminently sensible way to reduce household energy consumption and heating costs.
ex.zh: 改善隔热保温是降低家庭能耗和取暖费用的非常明智的方法。

tip: 常修饰褒义形容词；勿与imminently（即将）混淆。

senses.en: A tax or charge; to officially demand payment of it.

ex.en: The government imposed a levy on plastic bags.
ex.zh: 政府对塑料袋征税。

senses.en: Involving trust, especially managing money for someone else.

ex.en: Advisers have a fiduciary duty to act in their clients' interests.
ex.zh: 顾问负有为客户利益行事的受托责任。

senses.en: Relating to calculating insurance risks and premiums.

ex.en: Actuarial tables estimate how long people will live.
ex.zh: 精算表估算人们的寿命。

senses.en: An ancient practice seeking to turn ordinary metals into gold
A mysterious process that transforms ordinary things into something special

ex.en: The exhibition explored alchemy through old jars and furnaces.
ex.zh: 展览通过古老的罐子和熔炉来介绍炼金术。

ex.en: Although alchemy lacked a modern scientific framework, its experimental techniques contributed to the development of chemistry.
ex.zh: 虽然炼金术缺乏现代科学框架，但其实验技术推动了化学的发展。

col: the alchemy of creativity｜创造力的神奇转化作用
tip: 通常不可数；比喻义强调神奇转化，并非泛指魔法。

senses.en: A person who calculates insurance risks using statistics.

ex.en: The actuary predicted rising claims.
ex.zh: 精算师预测理赔将增加。

senses.en: Agreeing to take on financial risk for a fee, as in insurance.

ex.en: Strict underwriting reduces the insurer's losses.
ex.zh: 严格的承保可以减少保险公司的损失。

senses.en: Deep respect and admiration for someone or something.

ex.en: She handled her grandmother's old violin with quiet reverence.
ex.zh: 她怀着深深的敬意，轻轻拿起祖母的旧小提琴。

ex.en: Reverence for traditional craftsmanship can encourage communities to preserve skills that might otherwise disappear.
ex.zh: 对传统工艺的崇敬能促使社区保留那些可能失传的技艺。

tip: 通常不可数；对某人的崇敬用reverence for。

senses.en: Protection against loss, or money paid to make up for it.

ex.en: The contract includes an indemnity clause.
ex.zh: 合同中有一项赔偿条款。

senses.en: The process of taking a case to a court of law.

ex.en: Patent litigation can take years.
ex.zh: 专利诉讼可能持续数年。

senses.en: Giving official permission to use something, such as a patent or brand.

ex.en: The company earns money through licensing its technology.
ex.zh: 这家公司通过授权其技术赚钱。

senses.en: the rigid outer layer of the earth

ex.en: The lithosphere includes the crust.
ex.zh: 岩石圈包括地壳。

ex.en: The lithosphere is broken into tectonic plates that float on the softer layer of rock beneath.
ex.zh: 岩石圈分裂成若干构造板块，漂浮在下方较软的岩层上。

tip: litho-（石）+ sphere。

senses.en: A person or group that checks that companies obey rules.

ex.en: A consumer watchdog warned about the product.
ex.zh: 一家消费者监督机构对该产品发出警告。

senses.en: A group of companies or organizations working together.

ex.en: A consortium of banks financed the bridge.
ex.zh: 一个银行财团为大桥提供了资金。

senses.en: Ownership of a business, especially by one person.

ex.en: A sole proprietorship is the simplest business form.
ex.zh: 个人独资企业是最简单的企业形式。

senses.en: A viral illness causing painful swelling near the jaw

ex.en: The doctor checked her swollen cheeks for signs of mumps.
ex.zh: 医生检查了她肿胀的脸颊，判断是否有腮腺炎的迹象。

ex.en: Routine vaccination helps prevent mumps and reduces the likelihood of outbreaks in schools and other crowded settings.
ex.zh: 常规接种疫苗有助于预防腮腺炎，并降低学校及其他人员密集场所暴发疫情的可能性。

tip: 虽以s结尾，但作疾病名称用单数：mumps is。

senses.en: Forming a legal company; including something as part of a whole.

ex.en: Incorporation limits the owners' personal liability.
ex.zh: 注册公司可限制所有者的个人责任。

senses.en: The way a company, organization or country is run.

ex.en: Good corporate governance builds investor trust.
ex.zh: 良好的公司治理能建立投资者信任。
